nodes.title: Decoding a graph instance

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$, $n$ and a list of bits $b$, the encoding is $1^k\,0\,1^n\,0\,b$, writing $1$ for true and $0$ for false: $k$ ones, a zero, $n$ ones, a zero, and then $b$. Here $k$ is the target size and $b$ lists the pair bits of a graph on $n$ vertices.

nodes.summary: Writing $1$ for true and $0$ for false, the map sends a bit string $1^k\,0\,1^n\,0\,b$ to $1^k\,0\,1^n\,0\,\bar b$, where $\bar b$ is $b$ with every bit complemented. A bit string with fewer than two zeros goes to the fixed no-instance $1\,0\,0$.

nodes.title: INDEPENDENT-SET

nodes.summary: Writing $1$ for true and $0$ for false, the map sends a bit string $1^k\,0\,1^n\,0\,b$ with $k \le n$ to $1^{n-k}\,0\,1^n\,0\,b$. Every other bit string, namely one of this form with $k > n$ or one with fewer than two zeros, goes to the fixed no-instance $1\,0\,0$.

nodes.summary: Let $P$ be any property of a triple $(n, k, G)$, where $n$ and $k$ are natural numbers and $G$ is a simple graph on the vertices $0, 1, \dots, n - 1$. A bit string that does not begin with two unary numbers (each a run of $1$s ended by a $0$) is rejected by the language of valid instances $(k, G)$ satisfying $P$.

nodes.summary: A literal occurrence is a triple $(c, x, b)$ of a clause index $c$, a variable index $x$ and a polarity $b$. Two occurrences $(c, x, b)$ and $(c', x', b')$ are adjacent when $c \ne c'$ and they are not complementary, that is, it is not the case that $x = x'$ and $b \ne b'$.
nodes.title: Adjacency of literal occurrences in Karp's clique graph

nodes.summary: For a CNF formula $\varphi$ with clauses $C_0, \dots, C_{m-1}$, the list of triples $(i, x, b)$, one for each literal $(x, b)$ of each clause $C_i$, where $x$ is the variable index and $b$ the polarity. The triples are listed clause by clause in order of $i$, and within a clause in the order of its literals.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved

inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
